title: Axiom (A4) is equivalent to continuity of translation distance
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 2.4.4: let pi: L_S -> S be a map of topological spaces and suppose L_S is equipped with a continuous R-action exhibiting each fiber of pi as a broken line. Then pi satisfies axiom (A4) of Theorem 2.4.1 if and only if the translation distance function d_{L_S}: L_S^circ x_S L_S -> [-infinity, infinity] is continuous.

difficulty_reason: author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because Proposition 2.4.4 at author PDF p.16 reduces continuity of d_{L_S}: L_S^circ x_S L_S -> [-infinity, infinity] to axiom (A4) by restricting to a subbasis of half-open intervals, using symmetry and R-action continuity to normalize to U=(0,infinity], where d_{L_S}(x,y) > 0 iff y is not <=_{L_S} x; this is a non-routine equivalence rather than a routine definition check.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Identifies continuity of the translation-distance function on the fiber product with closedness of the order relation (A4), via half-open-interval subbasis reduction and normalization by the R-action.
